status_effects.explanation: Cottard's willingness to speak well of the narrator is undercut by the narrator's exposure of his vain, self-interested calculation.
The narrator moves from being long excluded from Gilberte's home to being warmly received as a familiar guest by her parents.

appraisal_events.evidence: Cottard... pensa que... dire que j'étais un charmant garçon avec lequel il était lié ne pourrait en rien être utile pour moi et serait flatteur pour lui, deux raisons qui le décidèrent à parler de moi à Odette
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator exposes Cottard's decision to speak well of him to Odette as motivated chiefly by vanity, even though the act incidentally benefits the narrator.

appraisal_events.evidence: les parents de Gilberte, qui si longtemps m'avaient empêché de la voir, maintenant... loin d'avoir l'air irrité, me serraient la main en souriant et me disaient : Comment allez-vous...
appraisal_events.explanation: Gilberte's parents, who had long kept the narrator at a distance, now greet him warmly as a familiar visitor, marking his admission into the valued social space of the Swann household.
